records.text: Candace Owens says Tyler Bowyer met Charlie Kirk in 2014 while Bowyer chaired the Maricopa County Republican Committee, where Eddie and David Farnsworth also served.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: and crucially the Bowyers the Farnsworths the Frantzves the Kolvets they're all just vibing around each other at all times and what happens crucially is that Tyler Bowyer is going to meet Charlie Kirk this year It is still not clear to me how they met, but we can state that Tyler (Tyler Bowyer) is the chairman at that time of the Maricopa County Republican Committee and Eddie Farnsworth is on that committee and David Farnsworth is on that committee.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms Tyler Bowyer met Charlie Kirk in 2014 while Bowyer chaired the Maricopa County Republican Committee. Searches did not locate a reliable contemporaneous roster proving both Eddie and David Farnsworth served on that same committee at that time, so the composite statement is only partly established.
